_comment: Top-level release pin consumed by setup.py. Semgrep ships as a pure-Python package on PyPI (with a native OCaml binary bundled by platform); setup.py installs it via `uv tool install` into an isolated venv, then verifies `semgrep --version` matches the pin. PyPI integrity is enforced by uv against `requires-hashes` in the lock. Bump semgrep.version here, run `uv pip compile --generate-hashes -o /tmp/semgrep.txt` on a supported host, and copy the semgrep-<version>-py3-none-any.whl sha256 into semgrep.sha256_source below (informational; uv is the enforcer).

semgrep.sha256_source: informational; enforced at install time by uv against PyPI
semgrep.licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later (Community Edition engine); Semgrep Rules License for Semgrep-maintained Registry rules

semgrep_mcp._comment: The vendor MCP server ships in the same package (`semgrep mcp`). No separate pin.
